applies_why: The judge text does not count any verse on a cited-in line as an unanswered witness; it instead says the relevant witnesses were answered, so K-G4's counting condition is not triggered.
quote: the defender answered the beget-pattern and naming witnesses in [CR3] LINK 4 and [CR2] §5, and the challenger answered hēs in [DR3] C2.
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: Because the judge treats the mentioned witnesses as answered, and K-G4 expressly excludes answered verses from being counted, the text does not count an unanswered witness in breach of the rule.
